mapper.select: SELECT p.account_id, p.symbol, p.quantity, p.average_cost, i.currency, mq.last_price, mq.quote_as_of, mq.stale FROM positions p JOIN instruments i ON i.symbol = p.symbol LEFT JOIN market_price mq ON mq.symbol = p.symbol WHERE p.account_id = #{accountId} AND p.quantity > 0 ORDER BY p.symbol

SELECT symbol, side, quantity, executed_price, COALESCE(executed_on, updated_on, created_on) AS executed_at FROM orders WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'FILLED' AND executed_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(executed_on, updated_on, created_on), id

SELECT o.symbol, o.side, COALESCE(o.filled_quantity, o.quantity) AS quantity, o.executed_price AS executedPrice, COALESCE(o.executed_on, o.updated_on, o.created_on) AS executedOn, i.currency FROM orders o JOIN instruments i ON i.symbol = o.symbol WHERE o.account_id = #{accountId} AND o.status = 'FILLED' AND o.executed_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(o.executed_on, o.updated_on, o.created_on), o.id
